title: P0.33: Control/UIBridge birth has priority over resource snapshot prebuild gates
description: Live proof after the UiOnly launcher fix showed the Python UI process stayed alive but UIBridge was unavailable because lazy VM prebuild paused on resource_snapshot_refresh_in_flight before constructing the control route. The control route owns the chat surface and bridge, so it must be born before optional resource-gated prebuild continues.
resume_hint: Completed in local Windows runtime. _should_pause_prebuild() now bypasses resource snapshot and recent-stall gates only for route='control' after heavy startup phases have cleared. Other routes remain governed.
next_action: Restart IABV and verify runtime_audit reaches lazy_vm_prebuild_control_done/UIBridgeServer started even while startup_truth_refresh/resource snapshots are still timing out or refreshing.
reason: The universal loop must prioritize its communication organ before optional metacognitive prebuild. If the app cannot receive user input, it cannot explain, remediate, or learn from the failure.
